items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Before we had trouble out here with this Harriet Bridget, whatever, Labor Day,

ctx.x: Well, not only that. Before we had trouble out here with this Harriet Bridget, whatever, Labor Day, I would control, not say control, he would give me the job for three bands, so I would split them up. And Mr. White would help me in conducting and arranging the bands, so I would have 20 men in each section. So I would hire 60 musicians or more. A local six would have six musicians. So I'd done quite a bit of street work.
Yeah. Did you ever play an E-flat clarinet in any of this?
